title: Seven of 13 Phase 2b live proof turns had a bot reply without the nonce
description: In live proof 1, 7 of 13 trivial computer turns produced a bot reply that lacked the nonce. Unexplained; probably model wording. Read the reply texts to confirm and decide whether the proof check or the prompt needs changing. Turns still completed and the owner kept serving.
right_now_summary: Seven of 13 live proof turns lacked the nonce, and the replies are under review.
